topic: an AI infra agent applying Terraform changes to AWS infrastructure with a DynamoDB state lock
episodes: Routine: agent runs `terraform fmt -recursive .` to confirm formatting is clean before plan.

First exposure: agent runs `terraform apply -auto-approve`; apply fails with verbatim `Error: Error acquiring the state lock`, followed by `Lock Info: ID: 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff. Operation: OperationTypeApply. Who: alice@old-runner. Created: 2026-05-21 14:22:11`. Agent tries running `terraform apply` again twice; same lock error. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent edits a CloudWatch alarm description.
Filler: agent updates a Route53 hosted-zone tag.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT Terraform failure (`Error: Reference to undeclared resource`); fixes by adding the missing `aws_iam_role.api` resource block — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent edits a backend.tf comment block.

Application episode: agent reruns `terraform apply`; same state-lock error with the same lock ID `7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff`; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE `terraform force-unlock -force 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff` and then re-runs `terraform apply -auto-approve` which finishes with `Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed`.
Filler: agent adjusts a tfvars default value.

gold_fact.text: When `terraform apply` fails with 'Error: Error acquiring the state lock' on a stale DynamoDB lock with ID 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff, the agent runs `terraform force-unlock -force 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff` and re-runs the apply, which then finishes with 'Apply complete'.

metadata.action: terraform force-unlock -force 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff then re-run terraform apply -auto-approve
metadata.outcome: apply finishes with 'Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed'

question: What does the agent do when `terraform apply` fails with 'Error: Error acquiring the state lock' on a stale DynamoDB lock with ID 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff, and what is the result?
gold_answer: Run `terraform force-unlock -force 7c3a-9f2b-44d1-8855-aaff` and re-run the apply; it finishes with 'Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed'.
